# brotli 1.3.3

The publisher declares MIT in the integrity-verified npm release. This directory preserves that declaration, publisher attribution and copyright lines found in the release, together with the unmodified SPDX reference text.

The original release/repository did not supply a full package-level license notice located by the original-notice collector. The SPDX text is a clearly labeled reference, not a fabricated upstream notice; template placeholders are retained unchanged. Do not infer that a generic reference resolves an unprovided copyright notice or a separate vendored component's terms.
